scripts.build: prisma generate && tsup src/index.ts --format esm --target node20 --out-dir dist --clean
scripts.db:setup: prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts && tsx prisma/demo.ts
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && tsx prisma/seed.ts && tsx prisma/demo.ts
scripts.build:render: node scripts/prepare-prisma.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma && tsup src/index.ts --format cjs --target node20 --out-dir dist --clean
scripts.start:render: prisma db push --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma --skip-generate && node dist/index.cjs
